title: 2025 AMC 12B Problem 16
statement: An analog clock starts at midnight and runs for \(2025\) minutes before stopping. What is the tangent of the acute angle between the hour hand and the minute hand when the clock stops?

solutions.text:
\(2025\) minutes is \(33\) hours \(45\) minutes, which modulo \(12\) hours reads \(9{:}45.\) The minute hand points at \(270^\circ\) and the hour hand at \(9.75 \times 30^\circ = 292.5^\circ,\) so the acute angle between them is \(22.5^\circ.\) Using the half-angle value, \(\tan 22.5^\circ = \sqrt{2} - 1.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Reduce \(2025\) minutes modulo \(12\) hours to find where the hands point
Find each hand’s angle, take the acute difference, then evaluate \(\tan 22.5^\circ\)
